name: Omazone
author: weedwhitesandwine
description: A multi-timezone clock that drops down from the bar. Track any number of cities with custom labels and icons, drag the Time Travel slider to preview a future moment across all of them at once, and rebind the toggle keybind from the settings view. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.weedwhitesandwine.omazone

barWidget.description: Bar icon that drops down a multi-timezone clock
